    <h1>Sim Racing setup</h1>

<div class="wrap" markdown="1">

{% raw %}
The Sim Racing module runs championships for any sim: a grid with reserves, results, standings that keep themselves up to date, and stewards for incidents. Finish [**Setting up Alagos**](/guides/setting-up/) first.

## 1. Switch it on

Run `/guild-settings modules` and press **Switch on** beside **Sim Racing**. Alagos calls your group a **League**; rename it with **✏️ What we're called** on the Overview tab.

## 2. Drivers

Your members add their own driver from **My profile**: their name, nationality, preferred car number, and the ids results are matched by (Steam id for ACC and Le Mans Ultimate, iRacing customer id, or their EA, PSN or Xbox name). Officers can add or fix anyone's.

## 3. Your first championship

On the **Features & limits** tab press **🏆 Championships**, then **➕ New championship**: a name, the sim, and what each round has (race only, qualifying and a race, a sprint and a feature, or two races). Then, in the championship:

- **🏎️ Classes & teams**: classes such as "GT3: 20" (the cars each has on the grid), or none for one grid; your teams.
- **🧮 Points**: F1, IndyCar-style, MotoGP-style or one point per car beaten. Your own table, bonus points for pole and fastest lap, and dropped rounds are Premium.
- **👥 Entries**: each driver with a car number, a team, a class, and full-time, reserve or guest (a guest races and scores nothing). Two to four drivers can share a car for endurance races.
- **🗓️ Rounds**: make your events first (the Sim Racing templates are ready), then add them as rounds. A repeating event keeps making rounds.
- **✏️ Settings**: set it **Running** when the season starts. The free plan runs one championship at a time.

## 4. The grid and reserves

A round's post signs drivers up to the grid, one button per class. Full-time drivers get their seat before reserves, whenever they sign up; a reserve fills a seat a full-timer gives up, and moves up by themselves with a direct message. Officers can still move anyone with 👥 Roles.

## 5. Stewards

In **⚖️ Stewarding** choose the stewards' channel (reports go there, each with a thread), an optional decisions channel, and how long after a round drivers can report (48 hours by default). Give your stewards the **Steward championships** permission in the permissions panel, alone or with the Officer bundle. Penalty points and race bans are Premium.

## 6. The standings post

**📌 Post the standings** puts them in a channel your drivers can see. It updates itself a few seconds after every result or penalty, and is posted again if someone deletes it.
